chunks: "Whoever washes a deceased person, then conceals and keeps secret, will come out from sins like the day his mother gave birth to him."

key_terms.الذُّنُوبِ: sins from which the person is purified
key_terms.غَسَّلَ: washed the body of the deceased
key_terms.وَلَدَتْهُ: gave birth to him, indicating complete renewal from sin

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for washing a deceased person and concealing what is seen?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue of washing the deceased while preserving their dignity and concealing what should not be disclosed. It promises great purification from sins for the one who performs this duty with discretion and trustworthiness.
